errors.evidence: The description states the x-axis scale ranges to approximately 70, but the labeled axis ticks on the chart clearly end at 60. The description confuses the maximum data value with the labeled axis range.
The chart is a horizontal bar chart, so the term 'longest' would be more accurate and less ambiguous than 'tallest' to describe the bar with the greatest value.
